integrity: Analytic projector and discriminant proof; independently reconstructed rational two-by-two transition check with 3360 rational cases; deterministic standard-library verifier included.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact endpoint matrices of the two-stage Radau IIA method on irreducible autonomous two-state row Markov generators only; there is no claim for internal stages, nonlinear systems or floating-point effects. Mathematical priority and the proof have not undergone independent audit.
title: Reentrant Markov positivity and the sharp rate-imbalance threshold for two-stage Radau IIA
